assumptions: Controller runs Node 24 (node:sqlite DatabaseSync available); @types/node ^20 lacks node:sqlite typings so a narrow shim server/node-sqlite.d.ts is referenced from app.ts.
Consent version supplied in the entry acknowledgement becomes the adapter requireConsentVersion, so consent_recorded payload.version must match it (identical gating to local demo).
Seeded adapter keeps default adviceForSelf behavior (advice available for both human and ai source), matching the existing local demo default.
Session participant identity remains adapter-issued (virtual-preview) with credential participation_mode/device_class seeded into session.metadata.
Admin export auth failure returns 401 with code SESSION_EXPIRED because the frozen error catalog has no dedicated auth code.
Cross-origin and oversized-body rejections use status 403/413 with code INVALID_EVENT from the frozen catalog.

Server build config (Vite SSR -> dist-server/main.js) is owned by the controller per architecture; server/main.ts reads HOST/PORT/DATA_PATH/ENTRY_CODE/ADMIN_TOKEN/STATIC_DIR/SECURE_COOKIES and refuses missing secrets.
remaining: External verifier must run: node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/server (not executed in this sandbox).
Frontend collection entry (bootstrap-collection.ts) and HTTP adapter are separate tasks per architecture; this task only covers the server backend and its integration tests.
Existing local-demo preview behavior preserved via additive optional seedSession option (no default behavior change).
